name: DeadPunk OS
description: A handmade OS-shaped index for text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and project-control tools.
identity: text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and small tools for keeping AI-assisted work operational.
github_pages_derivation: Each project GitHub Page uses the standard repository Pages URL derived from its GitHub repository URL.
readme: A small OS-shaped index for text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and project-control tools.
I built these tools to reduce drift, force useful decisions, and keep messy AI-assisted work usable.

interface.visual_direction: Simple fake classic desktop inspired by Windows 98 / Windows classic: blue desktop, gray windows, bevel borders, blue title bars, black CMD-like terminal area, and classic taskbar.
layout_notes: Project icons and desktop system icons are separated inside the desktop column.
Trash is a desktop system icon, not a project.
The inspector title bar is labeled EXPLODED.EXE in the UI.
The terminal remains visually CMD-like and black.
Green is reserved for the topbar status LED.
Desktop and laptop layouts keep long project views scrollable inside the inspector.
Mobile layout keeps the inspector in the normal document flow.

projects.title: A.D.A.M.
projects.route: AI response either hallucinates or brings a forklift to a teaspoon job
projects.job: Sets the answer depth before the chat starts digging its own grave.
projects.problem: Tiny questions get autopsied. Hard ones get waved through with a smile and a missing organ.
projects.output: LOW / MID / DEEP response control, with fewer theatrical collapses.
projects.note: overthinking containment unit, lid not included

projects.title: ai-protocol-kit
projects.route: AI-assisted work keeps dying from vague prompts, hidden assumptions, and optimism
projects.job: Hands the session a contract before it starts renovating the crime scene.
projects.problem: Without rails, AI rushes, assumes, publishes, and calls the debris a workflow.
projects.output: Reusable protocols for shaping, reviewing, publishing, and reader-facing output.
projects.note: not magic prompts; paperwork with teeth

projects.title: Memory-Assisted Shaping for GPT Project
projects.route: long GPT Project session starts forgetting which corpse was the original idea
projects.job: Keeps long shaping sessions from wandering off with the wrong decision.
projects.problem: Gates, discarded paths, and source boundaries vanish; the final artifact inherits the whole crime scene.
projects.output: Cleaner final artifacts after controlled shaping, with fewer ghosts in the walls.

projects.title: PA-PVP
projects.route: indecision keeps the work moving without deciding, like a meeting with a pulse
projects.job: Turns vague plans, artifacts, and stuck decisions into one executable next move.
projects.problem: Open-ended discussion keeps wearing different hats and pretending one of them is closure.
projects.output: Verdict, next action, probes, debt, and a continuation point.
projects.note: argues so you do not have to, then invoices your certainty

projects.title: PA-PVP mini
projects.route: idea looks plausible, which is how most bad ideas enter the building
projects.job: Stress-tests ideas, plans, prompts, procedures, code, and AI outputs.
projects.problem: Plausible material hides weak logic, missing constraints, and dead batteries under a clean shirt.
projects.output: Concrete findings and structural fixes before the corpse reaches production.

projects.title: Signal Rail
projects.route: project documents become a pile and start breeding in the corner
projects.job: Keeps live project material in the right place before the notes turn into landfill.
projects.problem: Decisions, open work, ideas, constraints, handoff notes, and archive dust collapse into one document-shaped swamp.
projects.output: Separated rails for state, decisions, ideas, constraints, handoff, parking, and archive.
projects.note: keeps mess on tracks; still smells like work

projects.title: CSBP
projects.route: Codex keeps making the same mistake until it becomes office furniture
projects.job: Keeps reusable Codex practices explicit, reviewed, and controlled.
projects.problem: Useful guidance either rots in chat history or gets promoted too fast into project law.
projects.output: A companion layer for practices worth reusing, but not strong enough to become project rules.
projects.note: not a rule, not a vibe, not another sacred sticky note

projects.title: SensecraftXStudio
projects.route: Codex is about to touch the work while the frame is already smoking
projects.job: Forces AI-assisted technical work to clear target, context, assumptions, and action boundary before touching files.
projects.problem: The assistant can stay confident long after the frame has quietly died under the desk.
projects.output: Visible target, context, assumptions, action boundary, and final state.
projects.note: confidence not trusted here; bring evidence or a shovel

projects.title: GPT-PF / ChatGPT Project Forge
projects.route: new ChatGPT Project starts from fog, vibes, and a folder named final_final
projects.job: Prepares explicit starting files before the Project pretends memory is a plan.
projects.problem: Projects start from chat momentum, loose notes, or mystical continuity and then act surprised when the walls move.
projects.output: Scope, sources, constraints, and starting basis before the real work begins.

projects.title: GPT Project Skill System
projects.route: ChatGPT wants skills, but the native slot is missing and everyone keeps taping instructions to the wall
projects.job: Gives a ChatGPT Project a controlled way to unpack, validate, and load only the skill needed for the current session.
projects.problem: ChatGPT Projects can hold files, but not native skills. This adds a controlled session workflow for loading skill-like packages without dumping everything into context.
projects.output: A Project-ready skill workflow: core boot, explicit skill loading, and adapter reports for checking whether external skills can run inside ChatGPT.
projects.note: skill slot sold separately; this bolts one on without pretending it is magic

projects.title: Cloudflare R2 Remote MCP Worker
projects.route: ChatGPT needs files, but your local disk is not invited
projects.job: Gives ChatGPT-style MCP clients a controlled remote place to read and write files.
projects.problem: ChatGPT does not work like a local desktop app with direct disk access. If it needs files through MCP, the endpoint has to be reachable remotely.
projects.output: A Cloudflare Worker that connects ChatGPT to Cloudflare R2 storage through remote MCP tools, protected by GitHub OAuth.
projects.note: tiny cloud closet, because local disk access was not invited

projects.title: Canon Boundary Guard for Codex
projects.route: Codex starts mixing repo evidence, chat residue, AGENTS instructions, and vibes
projects.job: Keeps Codex source layers separated before it edits the repo like a haunted intern.
projects.problem: Project evidence, chat context, agent-control instructions, working hypotheses, and model priors collapse into one authority soup.
projects.output: A Codex plugin/skill with a compact frame and highly recommended PreToolUse hook.
projects.note: keeps the voices in their lanes, with a clipboard and a warning label

projects.title: Canon Boundary Guard for GPT Projects
projects.route: ChatGPT Project turns uploads, chat, and assumptions into one cursed soup
projects.job: Keeps files, chat, instructions, drafts, and assumptions in separate lanes.
projects.problem: A Project can start treating files, old chat, fresh drafts, and model guesses as the same authority wearing different shoes.
projects.output: A zipped source bundle and Project Instructions for long ChatGPT sessions.
projects.note: source separation for chats that keep adopting every stray thought

projects.title: Shaping Frame for Claude
projects.route: Claude chat starts treating a fresh guess like a signed death certificate
projects.job: Keeps Claude aware of what is hypothesis, decision, or unvalidated generated material.
projects.problem: Normal Claude chats can smooth over uncertainty until everything sounds already settled and ready for burial.
projects.output: A Claude skill plus custom instructions for epistemic weight in long sessions.
projects.note: polite uncertainty cage for a model with good manners
